sources.observation: Twin patinated copper helmets, open lanterns, blue-and-gold clocks and the central curved screen face the green.
The ribs of the stepped copper bell roofs sit above stone cornices. The rounded central bay projects from the nave under a broad brown tile roof.

limitations: The principal cathedral, library and three connected abbey wings are modeled. Smaller roof heights, marble ornament and the sculpture of the central screen are photo-based estimates.
